title: This Month in Sea of Thieves: September 2025
summary: What’s that? Another month of shenanigans on the horizon, is it? Why yes, it is! As we step into the run of -ber months, kicking off with a pumpkin-spiced September, a feast of delights await you on our shores. Let’s get into what you can expect…

title: Mists of Pandaria Classic: Landfall Arrives September 23
summary: The first major content update for Mists of Pandaria Classic, Landfall, launches the week of September 23. It brings the Horde and Alliance into open conflict on the shores of Krasarang Wilds, offers an invitation from Wrathion to pursue Legendary items, opens the Brawler's Guild for players seeking challenging fights and prestige, and introduces even more exciting content!

title: World of Warcraft Midnight Information Round-Up
summary: World of Warcraft Midnight is kicking up a Void storm and to help you stay on top of all the news, we’ve collected everything you need to know right here. Check back often for additional information as we share more in the weeks ahead.

title: Take up Arms with Midnight’s PvP Updates
summary: In Midnight, we’re adding the Slayer’s Rise battleground, outdoor World PvP objectives in the Voidstorm, and Training Grounds to help you get your PvP legs underneath you.

title: New Challenges are Ahead in the Dungeons of Midnight
summary: Experience eight new dungeons, each with unique environments and storylines as you level up through the campaign. Face new challenges, defeat new enemies, and claim your rewards!

title: Hunt or Be Hunted with the Prey System in Midnight
summary: Join the hunt when you visit Murder Row in Silvermoon City. Pursue powerful targets throughout the zones of Midnight and reap your rewards.

title: Unleash Your Skills in Midnight's New Delves
summary: Take on new challenges through ten new Delves and one new seasonal Nemesis Delve alongside a new NPC companion—legendary blood elf rogue Valeera Sanguinar. You’ll experience more of the story of Midnight interwoven through new quests and even experience the great outdoors—taking the adventure outside for the first time.

title: Unlock the Haranir, a New Allied Race in Midnight!
summary: Play through the Midnight campaign to earn the trust of a new allied race, the Haranir. You’ll learn about their history along the way and explore the wilds of their home in Harandar.

title: Midnight: Get up to Speed with User Interface Updates
summary: We’re making improvements to Nameplates, adding Damage Meters to the base UI, integrating boss alerts into our raid design in Midnight, and more.

title: Midnight: Embrace the Void with the Devourer Specialization
summary: Introducing the Devourer Demon Hunter, a third specialization that utilizes the power of the Void. This glaive-wielding, soul-harvesting, and planet crushing spellcaster operates from mid-range with the full suite of mobility you'd expect from Demon Hunters.

title: Explore the Zones of Midnight
summary: Battle your way to a new level cap of 90 as you explore four reimagined and new zones in Midnight. You’ll return to the homelands of the blood elves in Eversong Woods, explore the capital of the Amani trolls in Zul’Aman, travel beneath the roots of the world trees to Harandar, and face the all-consuming Void in The Voidstorm.

title: Get a Glow up With Transmog Updates in Midnight
summary: We’re taking the transmogrification system to a new level with an overhaul to its functionality. Save to gear slots, style multiple outfits, and dress for the moment anywhere your adventures take you in Azeroth.

title: New or Returning, Take Your Character to the Next Level!
summary: Whether you’re new to Azeroth or returning to undertake the next chapter in the evolving story within Midnight, we’ve got you covered when the 11.2.7 content update arrives later this year. New players will find a smoother transition to get caught up with an updated New Player Experience. Players looking to come back will find a guided Returning Player Experience to help you remember how to play the game and get you on the path to the latest content in World of Warcraft.

title: Midnight: Come Home to Azeroth with Housing
summary: Build, decorate, and personalize your home in Azeroth with the new Housing feature. Players can earn their own house and plot of land, move into a neighborhood with other players, or establish a neighborhood with their guild. Boundless self-expression awaits you!

title: Battle Through Three New Raids in Midnight
summary: Face off against nine bosses split across three raid zones over the course of Midnight Season 1.

title: Phishing Emails Warning
